title: Auditory Spectrogram
text: Extract mel, Bark, or ERB spectrogram from audio, 1 input, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Frequency scale} sets Frequency scale of filter bank; {Mel style}, {Auto-determine number of bands} sets the automatically determine number of bandpass, {Number of bands} sets the number of bandpass filters, {Auto-determine frequency range} sets the automatically determine frequency range, {Frequency range (Hz)} sets the frequency range over which to design auditory filter bank, {Filter bank design domain} sets the domain to design filter, {Filter bank normalization} sets the normalization technique for filter bank, {Output center frequencies} sets the additional output port for center, {Visualize filter bank} sets the open plot to visualize filter, {Window} sets the analysis window hamming, {Normalize window} sets the normalize analysis window, {Overlap length}, {Auto-determine FFT length} sets the automatically determine FFT length, {FFT length} sets the number of DFT points, {Spectrum type} sets the type of spectrum, {Number of spectra}, {Number of spectra overlap} sets the number of overlapped spectra, {Apply logarithm}, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate and {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Frequency scale
params.values: Frequency scale of filter bank mel (default) | bark | erb

params.name: Mel style
params.values: Mel style oshaughnessy (default) | slaney

params.name: Auto-determine number of bands
params.values: Automatically determine number of bandpass filters on (default) | off

params.name: Number of bands
params.values: Number of bandpass filters 32 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Auto-determine frequency range
params.values: Automatically determine frequency range on (default) | off

params.name: Frequency range (Hz)
params.values: Frequency range over which to design auditory filter bank [0,22050] (default) | two-element row vector

params.name: Filter bank design domain
params.values: Domain to design filter bank linear (default) | warped

params.name: Filter bank normalization
params.values: Normalization technique for filter bank bandwidth (default) | area | none

params.name: Output center frequencies
params.values: Specify additional output port for center frequencies off (default) | on

params.name: Visualize filter bank
params.values: Open plot to visualize filter bank button

params.name: Window
params.values: Analysis window hamming(1024,’periodic’) (default) | real vector

params.name: Normalize window
params.values: Normalize analysis window on (default) | off

params.name: Overlap length
params.values: Overlap length of adjacent analysis windows 512 (default) | integer in the range [0, windowLength )

params.name: Auto-determine FFT length
params.values: Automatically determine FFT length on (default) | off

params.name: FFT length
params.values: Number of DFT points 1024 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Spectrum type
params.values: Type of spectrum magnitude (default) | power

params.name: Number of spectra
params.values: Number of spectra 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of spectra overlap
params.values: Number of overlapped spectra 0 (default) | integer in the range [0, Number of spectra )

params.name: Apply logarithm
params.values: Apply logarithm off (default) | on

params.name: Inherit sample rate from input
params.values: Specify source of input sample rate off (default) | on

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input 44.1e3 (default) | positive scalar
